partners.mechanism_chain: ATP2A1 (HGNC:707) —DISRUPTS→ Sarco/endoplasmic reticulum calcium ATPase (SERCA) activity (GO:0005783); ATP2A2 (HGNC:708) —DISRUPTS→ Sarco/endoplasmic reticulum calcium ATPase (SERCA) activity (GO:0005783); Sarco/endoplasmic reticulum calcium ATPase (SERCA) activity (GO:0005783) —LEADS_TO→ Impaired muscle relaxation (HP:0003701); Sarco/endoplasmic reticulum calcium ATPase (SERCA) activity (GO:0005783) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal keratinocyte differentiation (HP:0033734); Impaired muscle relaxation (HP:0003701) —LEADS_TO→ Brody myopathy (MONDO:0010977); Abnormal keratinocyte differentiation (HP:0033734) —LEADS_TO→ Acrokeratosis verruciformis (MONDO:0007048). **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of calcium handling in Brody myopathy and long QT syndrome 15 could lead to novel therapeutic strategies targeting calcium channel modulators or SERCA activators/inhibitors that could benefit patients with either condition, or related disorders of muscle excitation-contraction coupling.
